# My thinking as the farmer

I'm 63 now, been working this land for 40 years. My 4.1 mu isn't big, but it's mine. I grow cotton — that's what I know, and the soil here in our western part of Quzhou does better with cotton than with wheat-maize. I tried wheat-maize back when I was younger but switched to cotton maybe 20 years ago and stuck with it.

It's just me in the house these days. That's the biggest thing on my mind when I plan the year. Cotton is a lot of work — especially picking. I can handle the planting and spraying myself, but when the bolls start opening in September I'll need to hire a couple of women from the village to help me pick, otherwise the cotton sits too long in the field and the quality drops. That's maybe 10–15 days of hired help, and these days they want 80 yuan a day.

**Seed**: I buy the certified hybrid Bt cotton seed from the shop in town — about 50 yuan per mu. I don't save seed for cotton, the second generation doesn't do well. I'll plant late April, maybe the 25th, after the soil warms up. My neighbor planted too early one year and the seedlings froze — I don't make that mistake.

**Fertilizer**: I put down about 50 kg of compound fertilizer (the 15-15-15 kind) per mu before planting, mixed into the soil when I rotovate. Then at squaring, around late June, I topdress with 15 kg of urea per mu. The extension people a few years back told us 18 kg of N per mu is the target, but I do a bit less — my land isn't that rich and I can't afford to over-apply. Last year the cotton looked good with this amount so I'm staying with it.

**Irrigation**: Two times usually. Once at squaring if it hasn't rained enough, and once at peak flowering when the bolls are filling. The well is metered and pumping costs money, so I don't water more than I need. If the rains come in July I might skip the second.

**Pesticide**: Cotton always needs spraying. Herbicide before planting for the weeds. Then through the season I'm watching for aphids, spider mites, and bollworm. The Bt seed helps with bollworm but doesn't stop everything. I spray maybe 4–5 times. Fungicide only if I see disease, usually not.

**Tillage**: I hire the fellow with the rotovator — 60 yuan a mu. I'm too old to be pushing equipment around. He does it in a morning.

**Yield I'm expecting**: About 270 kg of lint per mu. Last year I got 280, year before was 260. I don't expect much better than that — the good farmers around here with bigger operations get maybe 320, but they have more resources.
